name: email-template-to-dnd
title: Email HTML to drag-and-drop design
summary: Turn email HTML into a design that opens in Brevo's drag-and-drop editor, and save it as a template.

tool_notes.email_editor_create_template: Always pass type (template or automation_template; default automation_template) and senderId when a sender is known. newsletterContent is the design from email_editor_convert_html, unmodified. Confirm name, type, subject and sender first; then read the template back and check its sender email.
tool_notes.email_editor_convert_html: Leave format json and normalize on. Before saving, tell the user what normalizer.dropped and normalizer.remaining list. Pass design unmodified as newsletterContent to email_editor_create_template; never yaml, never edited.
